# Bounded Exploration Budget

Cap wandering: each discovery cycle must reduce uncertainty about the next concrete edit.

## Explore purposefully

Ask before opening files: “What decision does this read unblock?” If none, defer.

## Escalation ladder

Start with repo-local conventions (similar files, tests). Escalate to broader search only when patterns are absent.

## Closure pressure

When time pressure rises, ship the simplest artifact that passes stated checks; elaborate only after green verification.
